scenicChapters.title: Castle Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 37 km this is Castle Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

castle-road.story: From Mannheim it runs 814 km to Karlovy Vary; allow about 11 h 06 of riding. On the way it passes Heidelberg, Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Nuremberg and Bamberg. It crosses from Germany into Czechia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
